title: In the dark the dead come where nobody is looking, and a light keeps them off
rule: Where a place is meant to be dark, the dead are not set out in advance: they come when a player's light goes off, only at spots no player can see, one to three at a time a few seconds apart, then not again for 20 s, and never more than two alive in one dark stretch. Turning the light back on cancels those still to come; a lit room (a fire, a lamp) is safe; a lit flare keeps them 1000 away for 30 s. Changes how our night and dark-district zombies behave: ask the owner first.
why: ep1_c17_00 (tunnel_darkness): logic_playerproxy OnFlashlightOff sends the charge to a logic_compare (CompareValue .7); OnLessThan > a relay > logic_case PickRandom of 3, each spawning zombine, zombie or torso at @1, @3 or @5 from npc_template_maker (CriterionVisibility 1, MaxLiveChildren 1, Radius 256) into 32 info_npc_spawn_destination (ReuseDelay 20, nearest neighbour median 114) along about 5000 of tunnel; each one gets an aiscripted_schedule to walk at the player @0.1; OnSpawnNPC shuts the relay and opens it again @20; OnFlashlightOn CancelPendings all three; trigger_darkness_spawners round the lit rooms disable it. Flares: prop_physics flare.mdl (5 in 00, 8 in 00a) OnPhysGunPickup > SetMinimumSpawnDistance 1000, back to 0 by a 30 s logic_timer. ep1_c17_00a: math_count_flashlight (max 2, fed by OnAllLiveChildrenDead) shuts the dark spawns while 2 are alive. The companion sees in the dark only in lit pools: env_global ep_alyx_darknessmode switched by 6 triggers, 25 info_darknessmode_lightsource (22 in 00, radius 59 to 512, median 128).
how: Gamemode: at night and in the infestation's dark stretches (docs/features/vortigaunts-and-weather.md, infestation-cleanup.md), dead that come from the dark could appear only out of every player's sight at placed spots, at most 2 alive per stretch and 20 s apart, held back while that player's flashlight is on or a flare burns within 1000; each walks to the nearest player (never Valve's !player, which is player 1). Map modules: lc_dark_spawn points about 100 apart in tunnels and cellars; lit pools of radius about 128 by fires and lamps.
check: A test: no dark spawn within sight of a player, none within 1000 of a burning flare, none while 2 are alive; robots.py walks a dark stretch with the light on and meets nothing.

title: Antlion burrows are shut by pushing something heavy over them
rule: Where antlions break into a district, each burrow is a few holes close together; a car, a skip or a crate pushed over all of a burrow's holes shuts it and its spore puff stops; while any is shut the open ones send more, faster; push the thing off and the burrow opens again. All shut ends the incursion. A new way to clear antlions, by hand: ask the owner first.
why: ep1_c17_00a car park: 3 npc_antlion_template_maker (pool_start 1, pool_regen 1 or 12 s, MaxLiveChildren 1, spawnflags 13344), each with its own group of 1 to 3 info_node_hint hinttype 400 about 30 to 40 apart. OnAllBlocked (every hint covered by a physics prop) > counter_BlockedHoles (max 3) Add 1 and that burrow's env_spore Disable; a spawn there afterwards (the car moved) > relay_Burrow_N_unblocked > Subtract 1 and the spores come back. A second counter (max 1): OnHitMax SetPoolRegenTime 2 and SetMaxLiveChildren 2 on all three, OnHitMin back to 12 and 1. At 3: Alyx's 'holes blocked' and the way on. ep1_c17_00: the training burrow (MaxNPCCount 4, pool 4, regen 5) OnAllBlocked kills the nag scenes and plays 'good work'. ep1_c17_01: counter_coveredburrows (max 2) fed by trigger_multiples (StartTouch Add, EndTouch Subtract) round the holes. All 11 antlion makers in the ten maps: createspores 1, ignorebugbait 1.
how: Gamemode: an antlion incursion (docs/features/infestation-cleanup.md: the cave's nest is not built yet) gets 2 to 4 burrows of 1 to 3 holes; a burrow counts as shut while physics props cover all its holes (a box check every few seconds), puffs spores while open, and the open ones spawn every 2 s instead of 12 while any is shut. Map modules: lc_burrow_N_M hole points, with a car, skip or big crate within 300 of each burrow.
check: A test: covering every hole of a burrow stops its spawns and raises the others' rate; uncovering opens it again; all covered ends it.

title: An evacuation runs in trips: a small group waits at a door, follows its escort to the train, and the next group is ready as the escort heads back
rule: Refugees wait out of sight by a door in groups of two to four; they join whoever comes for them and follow him to the train; one who boards is safe; the trip ends when every one of them is aboard or dead, so it never stalls; if a whole group dies, or the escort walks off without them, the next group comes out. Each trip brings a different answer from the Combine (scanners, then a dropship, a sniper, an APC, a breach), and soldiers left on a leg are cleared so each trip starts clean. People talk instead of text: a nag for the next group 10 s after a boarding, a citizen at the train door turning the escort back, one line from a boarded refugee when used. The first group cannot be hurt: it is the rehearsal. A new job or event for us: ask the owner first.
why: ep1_c17_05: counter_citizens_to_spawn starts at 4, then compare_repairroom_trips_FROM sets groups of 2, 4, 2, 2; refugees stand under assault_citizen_wait, neutral to the player, until trigger_pickup_citizens: SetSquad player_squad and like the player. At the train, trigger_citizen_boardtrain (filter_citizens): FireUser1 (leave the squad), FireUser3 (board), SetDamageFilter filter_citizens_safe. counter_citizens_boardtrain's max is set to the group size and fed by both OnUser3 and OnDeath; counter_deadCits (max = group) spawns a new group, and trigger_outStation Adds 10 to it. counter_trip_TO and counter_trip_FROM (max 6) drive 16 logic_compares: FROM 1 three scanner bombers and manhacks, TO 2 a dropship and soldiers @5 to 6, FROM 2 a random bomber and the sniper, FROM 3 the APC and a car group, TO 3 the trainkiller and roof soldiers, TO 4 a breach, TO 5 the area done and the last train. relay_resetparkinglot and relay_resetRepairRoom SetHealth 0 the soldiers left there. aisc_nag_evacNextGroup re-armed every 10 s; relay_denytrain (citizen_blocker, TLK_CITIZEN_PLAYER_DENYTRAIN) at most every 20 s; relay_use_cit_N every 10 s; filter_citizens_first_four (only !null may hurt) Killed when the first group has boarded. The last train goes when counter_everyone_in_place_for_barney_goodbye (max 5: refugees aboard or dead, Alyx and Barney at their spots, the player aboard) is full. ep1_c17_02: fleeing citizens run to 7 assault_rallypoints (nearest neighbour 148 to 640) that lead 72 to 1075 on to one assault point (tolerance 36, timeout 3); a second set of 7 leads to a second point.
how: Gamemode: an evacuation event, or a Resistance job smuggling people to the station or a trainyard, could run as trips: 2 to 4 refugee NPCs at a door follow the player who presses E on one, are counted aboard or dead at the train, and the next group waits when the last is done; each trip draws a different Combine answer from a short table; refugees cannot be hurt once aboard. Map modules: lc_evac_door (the waiting spot), lc_evac_board (the train door), and rally spots 150 to 650 apart that lead on to one gathering place for citizens fleeing.
check: robots.py: an escort trip finishes whether its group ends all aboard, some dead or all dead; a test that a boarded refugee takes no damage.

title: A Combine gate lets its squads out one at a time, a little slower each time, and a car jammed in it keeps it open
rule: A held Combine gate stays shut until its squad of three has gathered behind it, opens, lets them out at the attackers and shuts behind them; when all three are dead the next squad comes, each one 2 s later than the last, six squads in all. A car pushed into the gateway stops it shutting, and the way through stays open. A new kind of Combine post: ask the owner first.
why: ep1_c17_01a: relay_gateScene ForceSpawns ptemplate_gate_soldiers (3) and Adds to counter_gateWaves (max 6, which Kills the gate relays). rallypoint_gateSoldiers OnArrival > counter_gateAssault (max 1) > relay_openGate @3: barricade_1_door_1 open (2 s), a node link on, the gate's clip off, goalassault_gateSoldiers BeginAssault @1.5. counter_combineDead (max 3, OnDeath) Adds 2 to counter_WaveRestart, whose OutValue becomes timer_WaveRestart's RefireTime (2, 4, 6 s ...): the gate shuts, the next squad @1. trigger_car_detect StartTouch Disables relay_closeGate, EndTouch Enables it.
how: Gamemode: a checkpoint gate on the edge of the Combine's ground during an uprising (docs/features/escalation.md) could release squads of 3 up to 6 times, the gap growing 2 s; a vehicle or heavy prop in the gateway blocks it shutting. Map modules: lc_gate_<name> with a rally spot about 128 inside and the gate's own clip brush.
check: A test: the gate never shuts on a prop in its doorway, and lets out six squads at most.

title: A safehouse door has a slot: it slides open, someone looks out and asks, and the door opens on the answer
rule: The Resistance's door on the street is the plain slotted door: a knock opens the slot, a face looks out and asks, the guide gives the word, the slot shuts and the door is unbolted and swung away from the guest. If the guide is killed on the way, the slot opens and shuts and the door opens anyway: nobody is left outside. Changes how a Resistance door works: ask the owner first.
why: ep1_c17_02b, two doors: bld_a_frontdoor_1 and barney_door_2 (prop_door_rotating door03_slotted_left.mdl), each with a prop_dynamic door03_slot.mdl on it. bld_a_frontdoor_1_ss_1 (the guide arrives) > bld_a_lcs_1 (c17_06_password01) OnCompletion slot open @1 > bld_a_lcs_2 > bld_a_lcs_3 (c17_safehouse_password: slot close @0.5, idle @1) > bld_a_lcs_4 > bld_a_frontdoor_open_rl: Unlock, OpenAwayFrom @1; OnFullyOpen turns its node link on. outpost_leader_death_rl (the guide dead): slot open @0, close @2, idle @3, the last line @1.5, the door opens. Barney's door: raid_pre.vcd Trigger1 slot Open, Trigger2 Close, Trigger3 Unlock and OpenAwayFrom @0.7.
how: Gamemode: a safehouse or the base's street door (docs/features/resistance-base.md) could be the slotted door: E from outside knocks, a rebel inside (a player, or the NPC on watch) opens the slot (prop_dynamic door03_slot.mdl with Valve's 'open' and 'close'), sees who it is and lets them in; the knock and a voice, never text. Map modules: Resistance doors use door03_slotted_left.mdl with the slot prop on it.

title: Most supplies found lying about give what the finder is short of
rule: In a long fight through a city, most supply boxes and loose kits are not set: each gives health, a battery or ammunition for whatever the finder lacks most, by levels set on it (health first). Fixed pickups are kept for the few places where a thing is the point. Changes what our crates and cabinets give: ask the owner first.
why: The ten EP1 City 17 maps: 143 item_dynamic_resupply loose and 120 more inside the 148 item_item_crate, against 154 fixed items: 63 in 100 of supplies adapt. 114 want health full (DesiredHealth 1); pistol ammo 1 on 72, AR2 1 on 56, SMG 1 on 48; armour 0 to 0.5; grenades 0.1 on about 45. The hospital (02a) has 21 loose and 19 in crates, 03 has 43; City 17's uprising had 39.
how: Gamemode: a clinic cabinet, a Resistance cache or a supply drop could hand whoever opens it what they lack most (a medkit to the hurt, ammo for the gun in their hands), inside the owner's limits (docs/features/ammo-limits.md), instead of a fixed list.

title: A friendly marksman on the roofs moves to cover whichever street the player is in
rule: Where a player must cross ground full of the dead, a friend with a rifle takes a roof over it; each part of the ground has its own roof spot, and as the player moves into a part the marksman moves to that part's spot. A new way our rebel NPCs could help: ask the owner first.
why: ep1_c17_03: 7 assault goals assault_alyx_snipeposition_01 to 07 (rally points all at z 377, nearest neighbour 304 to 600) and 7 trigger_multiples trigger_alyxSnipePosition: StartTouch Deactivates every snipe goal and Activates its own @0.1. Below, endless street wanderers: npc_template_makers of antlion (5 alive), zombine (4), zombie (2) and fast zombie (1), every 0.1 s, only unseen (CriterionVisibility 1); each OnLostPlayerLOS sets its own health to 1, so her shots kill. ep1_c17_01a: Alyx becomes an npc_sniper to cover the alley, and her nags stop when the gunner and sniper she warns of are dead (counter_sniperAndGunnerDead max 2).
how: Gamemode: when players fight in an infested or contested district, a Resistance NPC marksman could take the nearest of a few roof spots to them and move as they move. Map modules: lc_overwatch_N spots on roofs 300 to 600 apart, each naming the ground below it.

title: A broadcast loops on the city's screens and is joined midway; when the Combine see you, the screens cut to them
rule: A message on the city's screens runs as a loop of short scenes that starts partway in, so whoever walks up joins it in the middle; between loops the screen is blank a few seconds. When a Combine camera finds the players, every screen near them cuts to static, then the Combine's face for a few seconds, static, and off, and the lights by them go out. Changes our screens and broadcasts: ask the owner first.
why: ep1_c17_01, 01a, 02b, 05: lcs_kleinercast to lcs_kleinercast13 chained OnCompletion on monitor_breencast_jumbotron4 through point_camera camera_tv_klienercast; logic_auto starts the loop at scene 5 @0.5; after scene 13 the screen shows camera_tv_blank @2 and the loop starts again @5. ep1_c17_05: pen_camera_1 (npc_combine_camera, inner 288, outer 408, invulnerable until then) OnFoundEnemy > relay_advisor_scene: monitor_room* static @0, the advisor @0.5, static @3, off @3.5, the broadcast's scenes Cancelled, sound_advisors @0.5 to 3, the hospital exit's light off with a spark. ep1_c17_01: the Combine's wall crushes the screen showing Kleiner when it falls.
how: Gamemode: the Administrator's broadcasts and a Resistance hijack (docs/features/city-administration.md) could loop their recorded lines starting partway in; when a Combine camera or scanner spots a wanted player, the screens near him show static and the Combine's face for 3 s. Sound and picture, no text.

A clinic under siege by the infested could run the same.
